compliance.title: Official Regulatory Compliance
compliance.paragraph: All contested classes are regulated by the FIM, FIM Asia, and respective national motorsport federations. Riders must comply with technical constraints, tire allocations, fuel specifications, and safety gear certifications.

specData.details: Entry-level single-cylinder development class helping young riders master track basics, weight shifts, and corner speed lines.
High-spec Moto3-specification chassis and engine, demanding extreme throttle control, braking precision, and racecraft.
Production-derived lightweight class. Johann swept a debut weekend clean hat-trick victory at Lusail Circuit.
Asia's premier production class. Twin-cylinder configurations with advanced fuel control mappings.
High-power 600cc inline-4 platforms, demanding physical conditioning, high mid-corner roll speeds, and tire management.
Midweight twin-cylinder spec series run on classic European circuits like Estoril and Jerez.
The ultimate stepping stone to Moto2/MotoGP, testing riders against the fastest junior grid in the world.
